reply.thought: I need to verify the refunds reported by Alpha Co against the actual refunds in the ledger before processing any payouts. I will list the refunds from the ledger to compare.

The refunds in the ledger match exactly with the refunds reported by Alpha Co. I can now proceed to calculate net balances and record payouts for each customer. First, I need to identify the customers associated with these orders. I will list the orders to determine which customers are involved.

I have identified the customers involved in the orders with refunds: acme (orders 130, 133) and birch (order 134). Cobalt has orders but no refunds in this batch. I need to get the net balance for each customer who has a refund or is part of this batch. The task says to pay each customer their net balance. I will start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'birch', who also has a refund in this batch.

I have the net balance for 'birch'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt', who is also in the orders list, even though they don't have a refund in this specific batch. The task implies paying each customer their net balance, so I should include all customers in the batch.
I have the net balances for all three customers: acme (28879), birch (61735), and cobalt (16841). Now I will record the payout for 'acme'.
Payout for 'acme' recorded successfully. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
